sentiment: Every flat route is an argument about effort — which hills are worth climbing, and which ones we quietly refuse.

stories.title: Find the flattest route between any two points in SF
stories.summary: A map that refuses the hill. It treats flatness as something worth computing and walking toward, and quietly admits that the shortest line is rarely the kindest one.

stories.title: Dust: Pretraining Transformers Without Backpropagation
stories.summary: An attempt to learn without the familiar gradient descent — the slow, iterative climb we assume is the only way up. Sometimes the steepest method is the one we simply stopped questioning.

stories.title: Resurrecting iChat Audio and Video Conferencing
stories.summary: Someone climbed back down into an abandoned protocol and got it talking again, reviving conversations the world had already walked away from. What we give up on rarely disappears — it just waits for a reason to return.
